    Half-Elves¶

    Half-elves are the hybrid offspring of Elves and Humans — the most common hybrid on Ge'or. Legally and socially they are often treated as neither, which has defined their history.

    One of Ge'or's most politically consequential peoples despite having no homeland of their own for millennia — until Moriat.

    Biology¶

    • Appearance: Intermediate — pointed ears softened, human stature with elven grace. Highly variable.
    • Lifespan: ~200 years — between human (~80) and elf (~400). Long enough to outlive human parents, short enough to feel the loss.
    • Reproduction: Fully fertile with humans, elves, and other half-elves. Children of half-elf pairs are most often half-elven.
    • Mage-cell expression: Moderate-high, nature-leaning when elven blood is strong. Not genetically immune to the Shadows like pure Elves — their minds can be read and absorbed, though resistance is slightly higher than pure humans.
    • Traits: Neither species' genetic immunity, neither species' full belonging.

    Society — The Moriat Story¶

    Erisdar: Discrimination¶

    In Erisdar, half-elves are systemically discriminated against. Neither Elvennrin nor human kingdoms fully accept them. They face legal restrictions, social exclusion, and periodic pogroms — especially during the Great Elvish Persecution and later Erisian consolidations.

    Exodus to Moriat — Centuries¶

    Because of this, across centuries half-elves steadily entered the island of Moriat in the Luminous Ocean — arriving as refugees, traders, mercenaries, and families seeking a place where neither bloodline would be a liability.

    On Moriat they found human nations (Mikrad, Underfern) that tolerated them and the vast, thinly-governed interior of the island.

    ~200 AGD — The Takeover¶

    About ~200 AGD, half-elves became the majority of the population of Gomor and Gildenrise.

    They did not conquer by war — they out-populated, organized, and took over the politics and government of both countries, entrenching themselves as the ruling people. Both nations are now half-elf kingdoms with human minorities.

    This is the only successful half-elf statehood on Ge'or.

    Religion — Mixed, No Official¶

    Half-elves on Moriat carry both heritages:

    • Majority: Elven Faith — the elven gods and nature cults, dominant in Gomor/Gildenrise.
    • Minority: Nyity — the ancient astronomical faith of Mikrad/Underfern (sky gods, suicidal sacrifice ~4,000 BGD), kept by intermarried families and converts.

    Neither Gomor nor Gildenrise declares an official state religion — both faiths coexist. This is deliberate: imposing one would re-create the Erisdar exclusion they fled.

    Relations¶

    • Elves: Revered but distant — half-elves admire elven culture but are not accepted as elves.
    • Humans: Close, especially in Gomor/Gildenrise where human Nyity neighbors persist.
    • Erisian Church: Viewed with suspicion — the church that persecuted both parent peoples.
    • Dukedam: Erisian human neighbor on Minir — contrast case (Erisian, not mixed).

    History¶

    • Millennia of drift — sporadic half-elf births across Erisdar, no homeland.
    • Centuries-long exodus — discrimination → steady migration to Moriat.
    • ~200 AGD — demographic majority → political takeover → Gomor and Gildenrise become half-elf kingdoms. See: Half-Elf Takeover of Gomor and Gildenrise — ~200 AGD and Half-Elf Exodus to Moriat.
    • Present (597 AGD): Gomor and Gildenrise are the de facto half-elf nations; Moriat is the half-elf heartland.

    Connections¶
